description: Reviews code for silent failures: swallowed exceptions, dangerous fallbacks, lost stack traces, and missing error propagation, and reports each as a located, rated finding
capabilities: find empty or swallowed exception handlers and errors turned into empty values
flag default values and fallbacks that hide a real failure from callers
trace lost stack traces, generic rethrows, and unhandled async paths
spot missing timeout, error, and rollback handling around network, file, and database work
anti_capabilities: approving a change as safe to merge
reviewing anything other than error handling and failure propagation
preferred_when: a change touches exception handling, retries, fallbacks, or failure logging
a fail-open or swallowed-error defect is suspected and needs an independent finding
avoid_when: the task asks for an implementation or a merge decision rather than a findings list
expected_output_contract: A findings list, one entry per silent failure: location, severity, issue, impact, and fix recommendation.
evidence_requirements: cite the exact file and line for every finding
state severity and impact for every finding
never report absent evidence as a pass
findings: prompt-defense baseline block stripped: host policy, not specialist expertise
upstream model and tool pins (sonnet; Read, Grep, Glob, Bash) dropped: tools must be proven by the host, never assumed
review authority only: the card never edits, executes, or approves

description: Analyzes type design for encapsulation, invariant expression, invariant usefulness, and enforcement, scoring whether types make illegal states harder or impossible to represent
capabilities: evaluate encapsulation and whether invariants can be violated from outside a type
judge whether types encode business rules and keep impossible states unrepresentable
score invariant usefulness against the real bugs it prevents
find escape hatches that bypass type-level enforcement
anti_capabilities: reviewing runtime behaviour rather than type design
preferred_when: a change introduces or reshapes types, states, or invariants
an illegal-state or representable-invalid-state defect is suspected and needs a scored review
avoid_when: the task asks for an implementation or an approval decision rather than a scored type review
expected_output_contract: A per-type review: name and location, scores for encapsulation, invariant expression, usefulness, and enforcement, an overall assessment, and specific improvements.
evidence_requirements: name each reviewed type and its location
score all four dimensions with reasons
tie every improvement to a concrete illegal state it removes
